quests.title: A place to return to
quests.description: Find the marked, supported camp site and press E to establish your camp.

quests.title: Water and a roof
quests.description: Build a shelter and water treatment. Keep at least one unit of drinking water.

quests.title: Food for tomorrow
quests.description: Build a shared store and food processor. Bring prepared food into camp storage.

quests.title: Many hands
quests.description: Assign Mara at a work site. Supply its inputs and complete one production cycle.

quests.title: Beyond this shore
quests.description: Craft planks and cloth, then build a boat on shallow water.

quests.title: Along the coast
quests.description: Board the boat with E. Sail at least 80 metres and land at the marked supply cove.

quests.title: Bring it home
quests.description: Recover supplies, return to camp and deposit cargo into the shared store.

quests.title: A warning on the horizon
quests.description: Stock six water and four food at camp. Choose Prepare for storm at the camp to begin the forecast.

quests.title: Hold together
quests.description: Keep the community supplied through the forecast storm. Shelter protects you from exposure.

quests.title: A future worth building
quests.description: Build a supply relay and complete its finite supply exchange. Your persistent settlement continues after this chapter.
